questions.question: A duplicate alert arrives for an open investigation. What should the system normally do?
options: Recognise it, avoid duplicate work and record that it arrived
Ask a model to decide whether duplicates exist
questions.explanation: Deduplication avoids repeated work while preserving evidence that the duplicate event arrived.

questions.question: Who should decide whether an action is allowed?
questions.explanation: Policy defines what is allowed. The runtime performs the action only after that policy check.
